info.title: SUtech Transport API
info.description: Generated from the front end's Zod schemas (npm run openapi). Fields are snake_case, times are ISO 8601 UTC, money is integer piasters, errors are { code, message }.

post.summary: Step 1 of sign-in for every role: texts a one-time code to the account's registered phone. Errors: UNKNOWN_IDENTIFIER (404), ACCOUNT_DISABLED (403), OTP_LOCKED (429), OTP_RATE_LIMITED (429).
Step 2: the same identifier plus the code. Returns a bearer token that carries the role. Errors: INVALID_OTP (400), OTP_EXPIRED (400), OTP_LOCKED (429).

get.summary: The signed-in account and its role. 401 when the token has expired or was revoked.
Server health and current server time (UTC).
Lines open this term, with price, bus type, free seats and the first pickup time. Names follow Accept-Language.
One line with its stops in order (name, landmark note, morning pickup time, map pin). Errors: LINE_NOT_FOUND (404).
The student's subscription for the current term, or null if they have none. The server moves an unpaid reservation to expired (and frees the seat) once hold_expires_at passes.

post.summary: Books a seat on a line at one stop and holds it for 24 hours until a receipt arrives. The price is fixed now. Errors: SEAT_UNAVAILABLE (409), ALREADY_SUBSCRIBED (409), LINE_NOT_FOUND (404), STOP_NOT_ON_LINE (422).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key per action; a repeated request with the same key runs once.

post.summary: Cancels a reservation that is not paid yet and frees the seat (to pick another line or stop). Paid subscriptions go through a refund request instead. Errors: NOT_CANCELLABLE (409).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key per action; a repeated request with the same key runs once.

get.summary: Term price, the university's bank account (NBE) and the offices for paying by Visa. Office hours follow Accept-Language.
The student's receipts this term, oldest first, each with its review status.

post.summary: Uploads a bank deposit or transfer receipt for a reserved seat. The seat stays held while finance reviews it. Errors: HOLD_EXPIRED (409), NOT_AWAITING_PAYMENT (409), RECEIPT_ALREADY_USED (409), RECEIPT_TOO_LARGE (413), AMOUNT_MISMATCH (422).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key per action; a repeated request with the same key runs once.

get.summary: The active subscriber's digital pass with a fresh signed QR token (valid 30 seconds). The app calls it again just before the token expires. Errors: NOT_SUBSCRIBED (403).

The active subscriber's next trip: date, their stop and pickup time, the bus, and where the bus is now (from its GPS device). trip is null for students without an active subscription. Live changes arrive on the WebSocket as bus.location and trip.status.
Announcements for the caller, newest first: official notices for everyone, and delays or changes on the caller's own line. Text follows Accept-Language.
